cron.description: Five-field UTC cron expression or a descriptor such as @daily or @every 1h. No TZ= prefix.

name.description: Name of the schedule. Names must be unique in the automation. At most one schedule trigger of an automation can omit its name.

concurrency.description: Schedule triggers only. allow starts a run for every slot. skip drops a slot while a run of the automation is not finished.

filter.description: Filter of the event. The provider and the event decide the valid keys, and whether a filter is required, optional or not allowed.

provider.description: Source of the events. teams and microsoft_teams are the same provider.

schedule.description: Schedule of the trigger. Required for provider schedule (event cron_fired), and allowed only there.

agent.description: Agent of the runs. It must be an agent of the definition. Default: the foreman.

enabled.description: If false, the automation never matches an event.

environmentId.description: ID of the environment of the runs. null clears the inherited value.

harness.description: Sparse override of the inherited harness. It changes only the fields that you set. Set auth to null to clear the inherited credential.

idleTimeoutMinutes.description: Minutes that a finished run keeps its sandbox and session for follow-ups. 0 ends the session after each turn. Without a value, the server default OF_IDLE_TIMEOUT_DEFAULT applies (10 minutes) to every run. OF_IDLE_TIMEOUT_MAX (60 minutes) is the upper limit.

machine.description: Machine of the runs: the name of a file machines/<name>.yaml. It replaces the inherited machine.

mcpServers.description: MCP servers that add to the servers of the agent for the runs of this automation. A server with the same name replaces the server of the agent.

model.description: Model shorthand. A Claude model selects the claude harness. An OpenAI model selects the codex harness. Do not set it together with harness.

runAs.description: The principal of the runs that the automation starts: factory, user:<email> or serviceAccount:<name>. The principal must exist in the team when you apply the definition.

secrets.description: Secret names that add to the secrets of the agent for the runs of this automation.

triggers.description: Events and schedules that start the automation.

workerHost.description: Worker that runs the agent. The value is trimmed. null or empty clears an inherited host.
